axis: the mean over the panel arms of each arm's failure rate on the task, shrunk by one pseudo-observation of half a failure and half a pass over the task's attempts, on the logit scale; the panel every arm with attempts on at least 90% of the set's tasks
estimator: D50 and D99 are the crossings of the average-rate curve at 50% and 1% failure, the median over every draw with the censored draws beyond the ends of the scale; the median-task D99 beside
